title: Jonah and the Confession
author: Isandro Pemberton
blurb: Silas Voss, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
